summary: Ryanair Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K announcing weekly repurchases of its own ordinary shares and shares underlying American Depositary Shares from 24–28 August 2026, totaling 205,259 ordinary shares and 138,416 ADS-underlying shares. Purchases were executed at volume-weighted average prices ranging from €23.27 to €24.18 and US$27.83 to US$28.81 per ADS. The buybacks are part of an existing programme announced on 20 May 2025; all purchased shares will be cancelled. No premium, advisor, or board recommendation applies. Watch for ongoing weekly announcements and potential capital return sustainability.
